eas_text: A civil authority has issued A EARTHQUAKE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Jefferson, OR; at 7:41 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 10:41 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert from Jefferson County Sheriff's Office: The evacuation level for The western side of the following zones: NW 17, 14, and 13 from north of Dogwood and following NW Deschutes up to the Warm Springs Border has been upgraded from Level 2 to a Level 3- GO NOW! Evacuate Immediately. There is significant danger in your area. If you need evacuation assistance call 5413842080. Leave Immediately
